say:1:1033103001:1.text: I knew it. No one can help us...
say:1:1033103001:1.source_cn: 我就知道，没有人能帮我们……
say:1:1033103001:1.male: I knew it. No one can help us...
say:1:1033103001:1.female: I knew it. No one can help us...

say:2:1033103002:1.text: No! I have to pull myself together. I can't let Patrick see me looking so down.
say:2:1033103002:1.source_cn: 不，不行！我得振作起来，不能让派瑞克看到我垂头丧气的样子。
say:2:1033103002:1.male: No! I have to pull myself together. I can't let Patrick see me looking so down.
say:2:1033103002:1.female: No! I have to pull myself together. I can't let Patrick see me looking so down.

say:3:1033103003:1.text: As long as I can just hold on, little Patrick will be just fine!
say:3:1033103003:1.source_cn: 只要我还能坚持下去，小派瑞克就不会有事！
say:3:1033103003:1.male: As long as I can just hold on, little Patrick will be just fine!
say:3:1033103003:1.female: As long as I can just hold on, little Patrick will be just fine!

say:4:1033103004:1.text: Tomorrow... Tomorrow I'll find a doctor for sure!
say:4:1033103004:1.source_cn: 明天，明天一定能找到医生的！
say:4:1033103004:1.male: Tomorrow... Tomorrow I'll find a doctor for sure!
say:4:1033103004:1.female: Tomorrow... Tomorrow I'll find a doctor for sure!
